title: FindingBase
description: Canonical $defs library for finding-style records produced by audit skills. Skill-specific finding schemas (e.g. research-accuracy-verifier/schemas/finding.json) $ref these defs for the genuinely-shared fragments — severity, confidence, location pinpoint, evidence array — while keeping their own enums for verdict and claim_type. Sprint 3 publishes the library; rewiring existing schemas to $ref it is a follow-up so the no-regression bar is preserved.

severityEnum.description: Universal severity scale across audit-style skills. Skill-level severity matrices map (document_type, verdict) → one of these four.

confidenceEnum.description: Self-attested confidence in the finding's verdict. Independent of severity.

section.description: Section name as it appears in the document (e.g. 'Abstract', 'Results §3.2', 'Slide 7').

line.description: Optional 1-indexed line number; null when not applicable.

url.description: Resolvable URL, DOI string, or PMID. Skill-level predicates (e.g. P3 in research-accuracy-verifier) enforce presence; reachability is a soft warning.

snippet.description: Optional verbatim snippet from the source supporting the verdict.

audit_id.description: Stable per-audit slug. Matches the directory name under research/audits/<slug>/.

document_type.description: Skill-level enum extends this; the base only requires non-empty.

coverage_caveats.description: Free-text caveats about what was NOT verified. Use sparingly; prefer findings[] for specific gaps.
